name: Amplify Magic Weapon Special Ability (Item Mastery)
body:
You can increase the damage output of a magic weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Use Magic Device 5 ranks, Craft Magic Arms and Armor

Benefit(s): When you activate and wield a magic weapon or ammunition that deals an additional 1d6 damage from a magic weapon special ability, you can increase this damage to 1d8. Magic weapon special abilities that deal 2d6 extra damage are increased to 2d8.
